name: esm_embed_sequence
description: Generate protein sequence embeddings using ESM-C (Cambrian). ESM-C uses transformer architecture trained on billions of diverse protein sequences to generate high-quality embeddings that capture biologically meaningful information about protein structure and function.

sequence.description: Protein amino acid sequence using standard 20 amino acids (A, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, K, L, M, N, P, Q, R, S, T, V, W, Y)

model.description: Model identifier used for embedding generation (esmc_300m, esmc_600m, or esmc_6b)

embedding_dim.description: Dimension of the embedding vector (960 for ESM-C mean-pooled embeddings)

embedding.description: The embedding vector as a list of float values, normalized to [-1, 1] range
